Name: Luumi's talkohlooeys Style Portraits for Hat Mouse Lacey
Author: luumiiii
Description:
[size=4][b]About[/b][/size]

I originally made this portrait just for myself to go with the rest of the portraits I was using for the vanilla and SVE NPCs. Since others might be looking for a portrait mod for Lacey just like I was, I figured I might as well upload it! It's not an extremely accurate recreation of talkohlooeys' style but I feel it captures the essence and fits with the rest of the portraits very well. I hope you all enjoy!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18177]Hat Mouse Lacey[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

-or-

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18177]Hat Mouse Lacey[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture

[/url][size=4][b]Credit﻿

[/b][/size]To [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78766618]talkohlooeys[/url] for the amazing art style and the original pack of vanilla portraits, and to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/188952864]ichortower[/url] for creating an amazing mod and an adorable NPC!
